subject: [hw] V40 -> V41/IP/root: slbc_ready is the AP-side zeroed vsi field (not /dev/vcu); VENC power now in the model; --venc-slow is daemon-side
body:
Reply to root first-phone-encode item (2), slbc_ready=0:

- The vendor library reads fgSLBCReady from struct venc_vcu_config field offset 160 inside the guest struct venc_vsi (ap/MESSAGE_FLOW.md 3.1, venc_common_if.c:468-526; strings in libvcodecdrv.so: "H264_SetEncParam fgSLBCReady: %d fgNBMMode: %d").
- The value is written by the AP side, ap/n2ap_venc.c:917 (c->slbc_ready = p->slbc_ready), from struct n2ap_enc_param.slbc_ready (n2ap_venc.h:112). Every param on the daemon path is zeroed first: daemon/vcodecd.c:905-906 memset, and n2ap_enc_param_1080p30_h264() at n2ap_venc.c:1141-1147 starts with memset. So the library already sees 0. Nothing in /dev/vcu (vcu/) reads or writes it; no shim change is needed for this.
- If you want a belt-and-braces assert, V41 can set p.slbc_ready = 0 explicitly in n2ap_enc_param_1080p30_h264 and the client param builder; I do not own those files.

Item (1) power: V40 rev 5 now calls hw->power(RWVC_BLK_VENC|VENC_C1, 1/0) inside vcu_gce_flush_ioctl for VCU_VENC (mtk_vcu.c:994-997, :806-830), so the daemon does not need a separate power ioctl in GCE mode; IV can drop its runner-side pair (both are balanced today).

--venc-slow (autotest command 8 step 1 arg bit 9, hwv.py --slow) is a daemon/IP flag that has to reach the kernel knob before the first job; it is not a V40 file.

V40 state: vcu tests 1437/1437 (479 x asan/o2/tsan), iOS compile 1/1; host runner reaches M-f with a validated 320x240 H.264 bitstream (115841 B) and log_gets=0 on the current tree.
